label: Read a solved project and report its resonance
notes: TEST EXAMPLE - edit before running. solve_policy FORBID means no solver run can occur: this task reads a project that was solved earlier and extracts S-parameter channels, then derives resonance / FWHM / Q. Point 'existing_project' at your own solved .cst (the Python result API cannot read a relative path), and point 'output_dir' somewhere outside this repository. If the project contains no '1D Results\S-Parameters\' channels the extract stage reports RESULT_NOT_FOUND rather than inventing numbers.
